title: Amazon Prime Day 2025: Best Tech Deals Recap
subtitle: A look back at the hottest discounts and what to expect for the next big sale.
author: PixelHunter
content:
Prime Day 2025 has come and gone, leaving a trail of empty wallets and upgraded setups. This year saw deeper discounts on flagship tech than ever before. Here is a breakdown of the top sellers and the deals that defined the event.

Top Seller: Apple AirPods Pro 2 (USB-C)

The AirPods Pro 2 dropped to their lowest price ever, making them an instant sell-out. With their improved noise cancellation and USB-C charging case, they remain the default choice for iPhone users.

Shop AirPods Pro 2 on Amazon

Runner Up: Sony WH-1000XM5

Sony's flagship over-ear headphones saw a massive 30% price cut. Their industry-leading noise cancellation continues to be the benchmark for travelers and commuters.

Shop Sony WH-1000XM5

Surprise Hit: DJI Mini 4 Pro

Drone enthusiasts rejoiced as the Mini 4 Pro saw its first significant discount. Its ability to shoot vertical video and its omnidirectional obstacle sensing make it the perfect drone for social media creators.

Shop DJI Drones
